page.overview:
What is Borhees?

was a small planet of reasonable wealth and size, ruled by the House Kolona and the Count and Countess Kolona. It had a 'tolerable' climate and was a member of the Imperium for over a millennium. The planet had rivers and river villages which were occasionally wiped out by floods and Ice storms were not an uncommon occurrence.

House Kolona was attacked by the Sardaukar almost two decades before 10191 AG. The Sardaukar were disguised as Atreides soldiers, shifting the blame onto House Atreides as the Padishah Emperor Elrood IX desired the planet's wealth. The planet became a secondary holding of House Atreides and Paulus Atreides became the Duke of Borhees but hardly visited the planet. Much of the Borhees wealth was absorbed into the Imperial Treasury. Years later the son of Paulus, Leto Atreides discovered that the occupation of Borhees was illegitimate and attempted to return it to the extended Kolona family heirs but the current Emperor Shaddam IV dismissed the notion in fury.
